name: civicbestiary
description: The Civic Bestiary - a field guide to the characters of the body politic, generated from one dataset into a book, a README and a prestruct-prerendered static site.

scripts.build: python3 build.py && python3 build_site.py && python3 build_schema.py && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.check: python3 build.py --check && python3 build_site.py --check && python3 build_schema.py --check && npm --prefix web run check:og && npm run lint:packs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build && npm run audit && npm run lint:graph && npm run lint:a11y && npm run eyes

author: dhaupin
